title: Four of the upload page's validation messages are worded differently from DR1's — DR1 says "Enter a date of issue", "Enter a real date", "Upload a document" and "You can upload a maximum of 15 files" where the frontend says "Enter the date of issue", "Enter a real date of issue", "Select a file to upload" and "You can add a maximum of 10 documents".

finding.frontend: The page's messages are held in one copy file (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:63-81). A blank date of issue gives "Enter the date of issue"; an unparseable one gives "Enter a real date of issue"; a missing file gives "Select a file to upload"; going over the cap gives "You can add a maximum of 10 documents". A blank reference gives "Enter a document reference", which is the one message that already matches DR1 word for word.
finding.prototype: DR1 raises, in the order the error summary lists them: "Enter a document reference" for a blank reference, "Select a document type" for an unchosen type, "Enter a date of issue" for a blank date, "Enter a real date" for a date it cannot parse, "Upload a document" for a missing attachment, and "You can upload a maximum of 15 files" when the collection is full (app/routes.js:9101-9148). The rendered summary on dr1-upload-documents-error lists all four row errors verbatim, dr1-upload-documents-continue-error lists the three that remain once a type has been chosen, and dr1-upload-documents-limit-error carries the capacity one alone.
finding.difference: Bring the four differing messages to DR1's wording: "Enter a date of issue", "Enter a real date", "Upload a document", and "You can upload a maximum of {max} files", in both language copy files, and update the tests that assert the current strings. The maximum in the capacity message stays derived from the obligation, so only its wording changes here — the number is the count-limit finding. The frontend's own extra messages — reference length, oversize file, wrong file type, upload failure, unscanned documents, virus found — have no DR1 counterpart and keep their wording.
finding.falsifiedBy: Submitting the frontend's upload form empty and reading back "Enter a date of issue" and "Upload a document" in the error summary.
finding.correction: Every string on both sides checks out verbatim, against the frontend copy file and against the three captured DR1 error DOMs rather than any page model. The title said "Three" while finding.difference asked for four changes; the title has been corrected to four and now names the capacity message too. Message by message, DR1 against the frontend: "Enter a document reference" / "Enter a document reference" — identical; "Select a document type" / no frontend equivalent, because there is no field; "Enter a date of issue" / "Enter the date of issue"; "Enter a real date" / "Enter a real date of issue"; "Upload a document" / "Select a file to upload"; "You can upload a maximum of 15 files" / "You can add a maximum of 10 documents". The DR1 side is one function, validateUploadDocument (app/routes.js:9101-9154), serving both exits with one set of strings — dr1-upload-documents-error carries all four row messages, dr1-upload-documents-continue-error the same three that survive a chosen type, and dr1-upload-documents-limit-error the capacity message alone, because the capacity check returns before every other check. On the frontend side the messages are copy.errors.dateRequired, copy.errors.dateInvalid (raised by the dateText validator in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/form/payload.js:23), copy.errors.fileRequired and copy.errors.maxDocuments. Slots otherwise left as written.

relatedTo.why: the capacity message's number and its wording are the same string
